title: Unit 8: Sporting Moments: Sports, Rules & Modals of Advice
objective: Mampu berbicara tentang perasaan terkait olahraga, menggunakan past continuous untuk menceritakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu, serta membedakan past continuous dengan past simple

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menggunakan past continuous tense untuk menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Kamu juga akan belajar membedakan past continuous (untuk aksi latar belakang) dengan past simple (untuk aksi yang terjadi di satu momen). Selain itu, kamu akan belajar kosakata olahraga, kata kerja olahraga (play/go/do), dan kata penghubung waktu (when/while).
rules: Past Continuous: was/were + verb-ing — Digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu. Contoh: 'Derek was running well' (Derek sedang berlari dengan baik)

Past Continuous vs Past Simple: Past continuous untuk aksi latar belakang, past simple untuk aksi yang terjadi di satu momen. Contoh: 'One of the players was hitting the ball when a bird flew in' (Salah satu pemain sedang memukul bola ketika seekor burung terbang masuk)
When/While: 'when' digunakan sebelum past simple, 'while' digunakan sebelum past continuous. Contoh: 'I was writing an email when my phone rang' atau 'While I was writing an email, my phone rang'
Sports verbs: play + game (football), go + -ing (running), do + activity (athletics)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Past Simple untuk Aksi yang Berlangsung
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering menggunakan past simple padahal ingin menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu. Past continuous harus dipakai untuk menunjukkan durasi atau aksi yang sedang terjadi.
commonTrap.wrong: Derek ran when he fell down
commonTrap.correct: Derek was running when he fell down

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan tentang perasaan terhadap berbagai olahraga

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about sports. How do you feel about sport in general?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I like some sports but not all of them. I enjoy playing football with my friends.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! What about swimming? Do you like it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I love swimming because it's fun and it's good exercise.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Are there any sports you don't like?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I don't really like gymnastics because it's very difficult and I'm not very flexible.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's completely understandable. Everyone has different preferences. Well done on expressing your feelings about different sports!

quiz.question: Derek _____ well when he suddenly felt a pain in his leg.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan past continuous (was running) karena menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu ketika sesuatu terjadi.

quiz.question: What sport uses 'play' as its verb?
quiz.explanation: Kata 'play' digunakan untuk game/permainan seperti football, basketball, tennis. Swimming menggunakan 'go', athletics menggunakan 'do'.

quiz.question: I _____ an email when my phone rang.
quiz.explanation: Past continuous (was writing) untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung, past simple (rang) untuk aksi yang menginterupsi.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: While I watched TV, the electricity went off
While I was watching TV, the electricity went off
While I watch TV, the electricity was going off
quiz.answer: While I was watching TV, the electricity went off
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'while' gunakan past continuous untuk aksi yang berlangsung, dan past simple untuk aksi yang terjadi di satu momen.

quiz.question: What do we call someone who does gymnastics?
quiz.explanation: Orang yang melakukan gymnastics disebut gymnast.

quiz.question: Derek crossed the finish line _____ he was crying.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'while' sebelum past continuous untuk menunjukkan dua aksi berlangsung bersamaan: 'while he was crying' (sementara dia menangis).
